text:
ana: FYI security advisory from our cloud provider: new org-level requirement going into effect in 7 days to block console sessions that don't present MFA and to require a session tag (aws:RequestTag/SessionPurpose) for all AssumeRole/session-based access. This impacts service principals that spawn console sessions or short-lived consoles via automation. Need org-wide mitigation plan.

sec-bot: Auto-scan: 12 roles/policies allow console access without MFA or session tag enforcement. Affected resources are listed in the report: s3://redwood-sec/reports/mfa-session-tag-1951234567.json. Severity: high (policy drift + compliance).

devops: Oof. Quick clarifying Q: does this block STS AssumeRole for automation (API) or only interactive console sessions?

ana: It blocks both in the sense that assume-role sessions that create console sessions or that use session tags are affected. The enforcement checks aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent == true for sessions that request ConsoleLogin and also requires aws:RequestTag/SessionPurpose != null for role assumption where the policy requests session tags.

sam: We should distinguish: human SSO flows must be enforced via IdP (ok), but CI/CD runners and scheduled jobs that use AssumeRole must be updated to pass session tags and, where possible, use non-console flow. We'll need short-term exemptions for a few edge-case ops runbooks.

katie: Owners please confirm for roles you own. We need owners to do two things: (1) add session tag enforcement and (2) ensure MFA for any console-capable principal. Default timeline: implement mitigations in non-prod within 36h, prod within 72h. Mark any blockers now.

eng-sre: Proposed immediate steps:
- blocklist temporary rule in WAF of the control plane? (no)
- policy-level mitigation: add a condition that denies ConsoleLogin if aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent != true.
- add a deny if aws:RequestTag/SessionPurpose is null for AssumeRole.
Test plan: apply to a single non-prod role owned by eng-sre, validate CI runners and scheduled tasks.

ana: Here's a sample policy snippet for the role trust/inline policy to deny unauthenticated console sessions and require SessionPurpose tag at assume time:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "DenyConsoleIfNoMFA",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "aws-portal:ConsoleLogin",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "Bool": { "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "false" }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "RequireSessionTagOnAssume",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "Null": { "aws:RequestTag/SessionPurpose": "true" }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

devops: For Terraform changes touching AWS IAM, remember infra-change-log entry and preflight plan. We should also add a PR gate that fails if session tags aren't propagated by CI runners (we can run a small script in the pipeline).

sam: I will update the CI runners to pass SessionPurpose and CIJobId tags in the AssumeRole call. Patch rollout: non-prod canary, 4h monitoring windows.

katie: If any partner integrations rely on unauthenticated console-style flows, we need to notify them now. Lina from solutions-eng will start outreach. (lina not in thread)

sec-bot: Added blocking alert to PagerDuty rotation: on-call must approve temporary exemptions via the security ticketing form. Re-scan scheduled in 8 hours.

eng-sre: Non-prod canary applied at 1951234680 to role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/np-console-service-role. Validation steps executed: attempted console link without MFA denied; assume-role without SessionPurpose tag denied. CI runner test updated to include tags and succeeded.

sam: Rolling to remaining non-prod roles now. Will post updates per 30m.

katie: Please document any runbook changes and list roles that require partner coordination in the ticket. Deadline for full prod rollout: 3 days from now. If you cannot meet that, mark ticket P0.

ana: After rollout, we'll add an automated guard in terraform-validate to flag policies that allow ConsoleLogin without MFA or that have Null aws:RequestTag/SessionPurpose conditions.

sec-bot: Follow-up scan scheduled in 24h and 72h. Ticket: SEC-2026-1087 (tracking).

eng-sre: All non-prod patched at 1951234820. No production changes yet.

ana: Thanks everyone. We'll review any exemptions during tomorrow's security sync and publish updated IAM runbooks. :white_check_mark:
